sentences.zh: 所以如果我们有一个巨大的数组，并且我们只想旋转一个元素，同时我们想原地完成，我们会做的是，既然我们在 GPU 上，

sentences.zh: 第一个元素就是我们要旋转的那个，而且它只有一个元素。

sentences.en: So we don't need to tile it.
sentences.zh: 所以我们不需要对它分块。

sentences.en: We can just tile the rest of the array, and then each block is going to grab one of the tiles, and then it's going to read one of the tiles,
sentences.zh: 我们只需要对数组的其余部分进行分块，然后每个块将抓取其中一个分块，接着它将读取其中一个分块，

sentences.en: and it has to write it back one element before, because that's how you would be rotating the array.
sentences.zh: 并且它必须把数据写回到前一个元素的位置，因为这就是你旋转数组的方式。

sentences.en: And then the first tile is also the one that's in charge of moving the first element into the back of the array,

sentences.zh: 因为这就是你为了旋转数组所需要做的事情，对吧？

sentences.en: So how do you communicate between blocks whenever a tile can be overwritten or not?

sentences.en: And so how I did that is that you have an array in global memory in a scratch buffer, where every tile has like an atomic flag.
sentences.zh: 我是这样做的：你在全局内存的一个暂存缓冲区（scratch buffer）里有一个数组，其中每个分块都有一个原子标志（atomic flag）。

sentences.en: And then it needs to pull the previous tiles flag so that it's sure that it can overwrite the memory location that it is going to write to.

sentences.en: And then once that flag has been released, it can write the cache tile to the destination.

sentences.en: And so whenever you do that, you're basically using those global flags to make sure that you're never overwriting some memory location that has not been read already.

sentences.en: So you're using those flags.

sentences.en: So the amount of extra memory that you're using there is very small in comparison to the size of the array.

sentences.en: Yeah.

sentences.en: And then, so that's basically the algorithm.

sentences.en: And that is because if you say that instead of having a rotate distance of one, let's say you have a rotate distance of, I mean,
sentences.zh: 那是因为如果你说，旋转距离不是一，而是说旋转距离是，我是说，

sentences.en: I think now it's better if we switch to thinking in terms of tiles instead of elements.
sentences.zh: 我想现在我们最好换成从瓦片的角度来思考，而不是从元素的角度。

sentences.zh: 所以想象一下，你现在正试图将一个数组旋转五个瓦片。

sentences.en: Then, okay.

sentences.en: Another thing I forgot to say is that whenever in the implementation, you're actually processing the tiles from the back of the array.
sentences.zh: 我忘记说的另一件事是，在实际实现中，你实际上是从数组的尾部开始处理瓦片的。

sentences.en: Because since you're moving them to the left,
sentences.zh: 因为既然你要把它们向左移动，

sentences.en: you want to start processing from the back so that the first block gets the last tile and the second block gets the second to last tile.
sentences.zh: 你就想从尾部开始处理，这样第一个块就能得到最后一个瓦片，第二个块就能得到倒数第二个瓦片。

sentences.en: And so that way you're moving from the back.
sentences.zh: 这样一来，你就是在从尾部开始移动。

sentences.en: Since you're moving the array to the left, you want to start processing from the back in order to get the best overlap in that sense.
sentences.zh: 既然你要把数组向左移动，你就希望从尾部开始处理，以便在这种情况下获得最佳的重叠。

sentences.en: And so taking into account that we're doing that, let's say we want to rotate an array by five tiles and we're only launching three blocks, then we would have a deadlock.
sentences.zh: 考虑到我们在这样做，假设我们想把一个数组旋转五个瓦片，而且我们只启动了三个块，那么我们就会陷入死锁。

sentences.en: Because let's say the first block gets the last tile, the second block gets the second to last tile, the third block gets the third to last tile.
sentences.zh: 因为假设第一个块得到了最后一个瓦片，第二个块得到了倒数第二个瓦片，第三个块得到了倒数第三个瓦片。

sentences.en: So you're processing the three last tiles, but then the first block wants to overwrite the memory location of five tiles before it, because you're rotating it by five tiles.
sentences.zh: 所以你正在处理最后三个瓦片，但接着第一个块想要覆盖它前面五个瓦片的内存位置，因为你是按五个瓦片进行旋转的。

sentences.en: But that five tiles before it is not being processed by any block.
sentences.zh: 但它前面的那五个瓦片并没有被任何块处理。

sentences.en: So it's just going to be waiting indefinitely until it can overwrite that.
sentences.zh: 所以它会无限期地等待，直到它能够覆盖那个位置。

sentences.en: And so you're basically going to have a deadlock.
sentences.zh: 基本上你就会遇到死锁。

sentences.en: And that's where that algorithm no longer works.
sentences.zh: 这就是那个算法不再起作用的地方。

sentences.en: And you need another way of doing it.
sentences.zh: 你需要另一种方法来做到这一点。

sentences.en: Okay, and so you have some other approaches.
sentences.zh: 好的，所以你还有其他一些方法。

sentences.en: That's interesting.

sentences.zh: 所以根据旋转的大小，或者旋转量，以及我猜你在GPU上拥有的并发量，你会选择不同的算法。

sentences.en: And then you have also an atomic counter on the scratch buffer so that you're doing a work stealing loop.
sentences.zh: 然后你在暂存缓冲区上还有一个原子计数器，这样你就可以进行一个工作窃取循环。

sentences.en: So whenever a block wants a new tile, it decrements the atomic counter to get whatever tile it needs to process.
sentences.zh: 所以每当一个块需要一个新的瓦片时，它就会使原子计数器递减，以获取它需要处理的任何瓦片。

sentences.en: And so that way you have load balancing implemented into that as well.
sentences.zh: 这样一来，你的实现中也融入了负载均衡。

sentences.en: Yeah, and there's a bunch of, there's a bunch of like hardware and software factors, like the disaggregation of the disaggregation of ML inference,

sentences.en: GPU core is now this like crazy asynchronous thing and programming, it's kind of a nightmare.

sentences.en: I should clarify.

sentences.en: Programming, it's kind of a nightmare if you program it the way that we programmed GPUs 10 years ago, because the GPU today is very different.
sentences.zh: 编程，如果你按照我们10年前给GPU编程的方式去编程，它有点像是一场噩梦，因为今天的GPU已经非常不同了。

sentences.en: And so we need new abstractions.
sentences.zh: 所以我们需要新的抽象。

sentences.en: And that's why things like cute DSL, like CUDA tile, et cetera, have all come about is because like the GPU itself is just different than it was.
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么像cute DSL、CUDA tile等事物会涌现出来，因为GPU本身与过去不同了。

sentences.en: And so we're sort of like struggling with that problem.
sentences.zh: 所以我们有点在与这个问题作斗争。

sentences.en: So wait, why is raw kernel authoring complicated by what you just said?
sentences.zh: 等等，为什么你刚才说的那些会让编写原生内核变得复杂？

sentences.en: Because the traditional view is that like you think about a processor core, right?
sentences.zh: 因为传统的观点是，你会去想一个处理器核心，对吧？

sentences.en: Like, you know, you issue a load instruction, you issue like a, you do some indexing math, then you do like an FMA, then you have like a store instruction, right?
sentences.zh: 比如，你知道的，你发出一个加载指令，你发出一个，你做一些索引数学运算，然后你做一个FMA，然后你有一个存储指令，对吧？

sentences.en: And like that's, those are all things that are executed by a processor core, right?
sentences.zh: 这些都是由处理器核心执行的事情，对吧？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: Yeah, that's not how that works.
sentences.zh: 是的，情况可不是这样的。

sentences.en: Because like there is no processor core.
sentences.zh: 因为根本没有处理器核心。

sentences.en: There's a load and store unit.
sentences.zh: 有一个加载和存储单元。

sentences.en: There's an ALU unit that's doing your indexing math.
sentences.zh: 有一个执行索引数学运算的ALU单元。

sentences.en: There's an FMA unit that's doing your, you know, your fused multiply add that's doing your actual like hard math.
sentences.zh: 有一个FMA单元在做你的，你知道的，融合乘加运算，也就是在做你实际的硬核数学运算。

sentences.en: You have a special math functions unit that's doing things like your cosines, your signs, your exponents, et cetera.
sentences.zh: 你有一个特殊的数学函数单元，用来做余弦、正弦、指数等事情。

sentences.en: Those are all different like pieces of hardware that the abstraction that we've had in software for like the last 50 years has been that they're like this monolithic thing.
sentences.zh: 这些都是不同的硬件部件，我们在软件中沿用了几十年的抽象概念是它们是一个整体。

sentences.en: But in reality, like each of these separate operations is executed by a different piece of hardware.
sentences.zh: 但实际上，这些独立的操作中的每一个都是由不同的硬件部件执行的。

sentences.en: And what's happened over the past, you know, nine, 10 years is we've slowly exposed more and more of that asynchrony to you, the programmer.
sentences.zh: 在过去的，你知道的，九、十年里发生的事情是，我们慢慢地把越来越多的这种异步性暴露给你，也就是程序员。

sentences.en: So now like there's a bunch of different ways to issue asynchronous loads and stores within a thread in CUDA.
sentences.zh: 所以现在，在CUDA中，有一个线程内部发出异步加载和存储的各种不同方法。

sentences.en: And the way that you issue instructions to the tensor cores that do the matrix multiplication, those are asynchronous operations.
sentences.zh: 而你向执行矩阵乘法的张量核心发出指令的方式，那些都是异步操作。

sentences.en: So now like within each thread, you're not just like, oh, I do a load, then I do a map mall, then I do a store.
sentences.zh: 所以现在在每个线程内部，你不仅仅是说，哦，我做一个加载，然后我做一个矩阵乘法，然后我做一个存储。

sentences.en: It's like you asynchronously launch a load, you asynchronously launch a map mall, you asynchronously launch a store.
sentences.zh: 而是像：你异步启动一个加载，你异步启动一个矩阵乘法，你异步启动一个存储。

sentences.en: And then like, you have to like, if you want to get full utilization, you have to overlap the compute and the communication.
sentences.zh: 然后，如果你想获得充分的利用，你必须让计算和通信重叠。

sentences.en: So it's like, oh, I start launching like this load, and then I do some compute, and then I launch the store.
sentences.zh: 所以就像，哦，我开始启动这个加载，然后我做一些计算，然后我启动存储。

sentences.en: And then by the time I've done that, the load that I launched has landed and I can start doing the next thing.
sentences.zh: 等我做完这些的时候，我启动的加载已经完成了，我可以开始做下一件事了。

sentences.en: And so you have to do this pipelining, and you have to do this thing called warp specialization,
sentences.zh: 所以你必须进行这种流水线化，你必须做一件叫做warp专业化的事情，

sentences.en: where you have some of your SM cores that are doing the dispatching of work to the tensor cores, and some that are doing compute,
sentences.zh: 在这里，你的一些SM核心负责向张量核心分派工作，一些负责计算，

sentences.en: and some that are just dispatching the IO operations, etc.
sentences.zh: 还有一些只是分派IO操作，等等。

sentences.en: So now you have to have this tasking model.
sentences.zh: 所以现在你必须拥有这种任务模型。

sentences.en: And if you're writing CUDA kernels, the way that you wrote CUDA kernels 10 years ago, this is like you're either not taking advantage of this,
sentences.zh: 如果你在编写CUDA内核时，采用的是10年前编写CUDA内核的方式，这就好比你要么没有利用这一点，

sentences.en: in which case your performance is bad, or your code is really, really ugly and awful.
sentences.zh: 在这种情况下你的性能很差，要么你的代码真的非常非常丑陋和糟糕。

sentences.en: And so we're building like new abstractions, things like CUDA DSL, things like CUDA tile, etc, that abstract over these things and make CUDA programming simple and easy again,
sentences.zh: 所以我们正在构建新的抽象，比如CUDA DSL、CUDA tile等，它们对这些东西进行了抽象，使CUDA编程再次变得简单容易，

sentences.en: and also performance portable.
sentences.zh: 并且具备性能可移植性。

sentences.en: Simple and easy again, that's a funny statement.
sentences.zh: 再次变得简单容易，这真是个有趣的说法。

sentences.en: As if at any point, CUDA kernel authoring has been an easy endeavor.
sentences.zh: 就好像在任何时候，编写CUDA内核都是一件轻松的事情似的。

sentences.en: CUDA kernel authoring has never been easier than it is today, because you can write something like CUDA tile, and you can't,
sentences.zh: 编写CUDA内核从来没有像今天这样容易，因为你可以编写类似CUDA tile的东西，而你不能，

sentences.en: which is like a very small diff on how you'd write something in NumPy and PyTorch.
sentences.zh: 这就像你在NumPy和PyTorch中编写代码的一个非常小的差异。

sentences.en: And you can write that, you can write Triton, there's like three or four other DSLs like this, where you can write very high level code, and you can get the fastest performance.
sentences.zh: 你可以编写它，你可以编写Triton，还有其他三四个这样的DSL，你可以在其中编写非常高级的代码，并且可以获得最快的性能。

sentences.en: You can get better performance than you'd get writing the low level code, that would be the equivalent of it.
sentences.zh: 你可以获得比编写低级代码更好的性能，而那将是等价的。

sentences.en: I see.
sentences.zh: 我明白了。

sentences.en: And you can write that code, and you can get performance portability.
sentences.zh: 你可以编写那样的代码，并且你可以获得性能可移植性。

sentences.en: So I mean, is this all to say that the work that Marco's doing is like suffering compared?
sentences.zh: 所以我的意思是，这是否意味着马可正在做的工作与此相比是在受苦？

sentences.en: Because I didn't hear any of that asynchrony stuff.
sentences.zh: 因为我没听到任何关于异步性的内容。

sentences.en: Or is it simple enough because we're just copying stuff around that we're not going to suffer from?
sentences.zh: 或者是因为我们只是在到处复制东西，所以足够简单，我们不会受到影响？

sentences.en: You can't write what Marco is writing easily in something like tile, because what Marco is writing is fundamentally more of a communication primitive than just pure compute.
sentences.zh: 你不能在像tile这样的东西中轻易写出马可正在写的东西，因为马可正在写的东西本质上更多是一种通信原语，而不仅仅是纯计算。

sentences.en: And by communication primitive, I mean, like, what's one of the main things we talked about in this algorithm is how do you know when another,
sentences.zh: 而我所说的通信原语是指，在这个算法中我们谈论的主要事情之一是，你怎么知道另一个，

sentences.en: when like you can overwrite the like incoming tile?
sentences.zh: 什么时候你可以覆盖传入的瓦片？

sentences.en: So just like scan or reduce, this is more about how do threads communicate and talk to each other.
sentences.zh: 就像扫描或归约一样，这更多关乎线程之间如何通信和对话。

sentences.en: This is a fundamental building block that you need to be able to expose to a higher level dialect.
sentences.zh: 这是一个你需要能够向更高层级方言公开的基本构建块。

sentences.en: So now I think this is like the rare case of an example of something that you do still need to write, or maybe it's not the rare case.
sentences.zh: 所以现在我认为这是一个罕见的例子，证明了仍然需要编写某些东西，或者也许这并不罕见。

sentences.en: But given that the communication is not at the thread level, but at the tile level, would it not be possible to still do it in CUDA tile?
sentences.zh: 但鉴于通信不是在线程级别，而是在瓦片级别，难道不能仍在CUDA tile中做到这一点吗？

sentences.en: It might be.
sentences.zh: 也许可以。

sentences.en: I mean, maybe, maybe.
sentences.zh: 我是说，也许，也许。

sentences.en: Because that's actually a question that I wanted to ask you.
sentences.zh: 因为这实际上是我一直想问你的一个问题。

sentences.en: Because I think, I mean, the other thing, we haven't talked about that yet, because the challenge of the actual implementation is that you have a lot of unaligned memory movement.
sentences.zh: 因为我认为，另一件事是，我们还没有讨论过这个，因为实际实现的挑战在于你有很多不对齐的内存移动。

sentences.en: Because GPUs are very sensitive, and the bandwidth, the memory bandwidth of a GPU is very sensitive to the alignment and the size of your loads and stores.
sentences.zh: 因为GPU非常敏感，GPU的内存带宽对加载和存储的对齐方式以及大小非常敏感。

sentences.en: And in this implementation, you have a lot of unaligned loads and stores, and you need to move around that in specific ways, which is what I talked about in the presentation.
sentences.zh: 在这个实现中，你有很多不对齐的加载和存储，你需要以特定的方式处理这些问题，这就是我在演讲中谈到的内容。

sentences.en: And so I'm interested, I would be interested to know if something like that is possible in CUDA tile, where it takes care of maximizing the performance of the memory movement,
sentences.zh: 所以我有兴趣，我很想知道在CUDA tile中是否有可能实现这样的一点，即它负责最大化内存移动的性能，

sentences.en: no matter what the alignment is or other characteristics.
sentences.zh: 无论对齐方式或其他特征如何。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: So, I mean, initially, hearing the unaligned thing, my initial reaction is, is there some way we could pad?
sentences.zh: 所以，我的意思是，最初听到不对齐的事情时，我的第一反应是，我们有没有什么办法可以进行填充？

sentences.en: And I think the equivalent of padding here would be some form of like, could we over rotate?
sentences.zh: 我想这里的填充相当于某种形式的：我们能不能过度旋转？

sentences.en: Could you rotate to the next alignment, and then like, correct?
sentences.zh: 你能不能旋转到下一个对齐位置，然后再进行修正？

sentences.en: And I think that that's always going to be like, it's just the idea off the top of my head.
sentences.zh: 我觉得这总是会像……这只是我脑海中闪过的想法。

sentences.en: I don't think that helps you because I think it's just as expensive to over align and then correct.
sentences.zh: 我认为这帮不了你，因为我认为过度对齐然后修正的开销是一样的。

sentences.en: But like, if you could, if you think about like something like a transpose, where a transpose, when you decompose it into tiles, there's like you, you,
sentences.zh: 但如果你能想象类似于转置的操作，当把转置分解成瓦片时，你会，你，

sentences.en: you transpose the tile locally, and then like you transpose the entire tile when you write it back into global memory.
sentences.zh: 在局部转置瓦片，然后当你把它写回全局内存时转置整个瓦片。

sentences.en: So it's like two step, there's like a local operation, and there's a global operation.
sentences.zh: 所以这是两步的，有一个局部操作，还有一个全局操作。

sentences.en: The thing that would be great would be with rotate, if you could have the same thing, where like, if you over rotated, and were able to do like aligned accesses,
sentences.zh: 最棒的事情是，对于旋转，如果你也能有同样的效果，即如果你过度旋转，并且能够进行对齐访问，

sentences.en: when you do the load from global memory, and then you like, you had to do some extra work to do a correction, but that, and that correction would be the, the unaligned part.
sentences.zh: 当你从全局内存进行加载时，然后你必须做一些额外的工作来进行修正，而那个修正就是不对齐的部分。

sentences.en: But that correction only happened at the L2 level, like at worst, it would hit the L2, then that might be, you know, worth it.
sentences.zh: 但那个修正只发生在L2级别，最坏的情况下它会命中L2，那么这可能就，你知道的，是值得的。

sentences.en: But I don't know whether that's just a very off the top of my head.
sentences.zh: 但我不知道这是否只是我随口想到的。

sentences.en: I don't know.
sentences.zh: 我不知道。

sentences.en: I think as long as you're having, you're having extra memory movement, so you're getting further away from the theoretical maximum performance.
sentences.zh: 我认为只要你在进行额外的内存移动，就会导致性能偏离理论上的最大值。

sentences.en: What I did, basically, is we, if you imagine the rotate distance of one, and we imagine that our array is aligned to a sector boundary, so it's 32 byte align,
sentences.zh: 我基本上是这样做的：如果我们设想旋转距离为1，并且设想我们的数组是对齐到扇区边界的，也就是32字节对齐，

sentences.en: which is basically perfect alignment.
sentences.zh: 这基本上是完美的对齐。

sentences.en: So you're one off that perfect alignment, whenever you, whenever you want to copy your, your first time to shared memory.
sentences.zh: 因此，每当你想把第一次的数据复制到共享内存时，你总是会跟这种完美对齐偏差一个位置。

sentences.en: And so what you can do is that you can just over copy.
sentences.zh: 所以你能做的事就是进行超额复制。

sentences.en: So you align the tile to the sector boundary, so to the previous sector boundary, which would be, in this case, the beginning of the array,
sentences.zh: 你将分块对齐到扇区边界，也就是前一个扇区边界，在这个例子中就是数组的起点，

sentences.en: and then you copy all of that instead of starting from that unaligned position.
sentences.zh: 然后你复制所有这些数据，而不是从那个未对齐的位置开始。

sentences.en: And then that way you're doing, it's called over copying, where you just copy more than you actually need to, but that way you copy in an aligned fashion,
sentences.zh: 这样一来，这种做法被称为超额复制，也就是你复制的内容比实际需要的多，但这样你就能以对齐的方式进行复制，

sentences.en: and so you get the best performance there.
sentences.zh: 从而在那里获得最佳性能。

sentences.en: But then in shared memory, the tile that you're actually interested in is still unaligned.
sentences.zh: 但随后在共享内存中，你真正感兴趣的那块数据依然是未对齐的。

sentences.en: And so what I did in that case is that I copied into registers, and then aligned it into registers, so to speak, and then you can do aligned stores back into global memory.
sentences.zh: 所以在这种情况下，我所做的是先复制到寄存器中，然后在寄存器中进行对齐，可以这么说，接着你就能以对齐的存储方式写回全局内存。

sentences.en: And so you can, you can use an instruction that is called a funnel shift, where you just copy eight bytes.
sentences.zh: 所以你可以使用一种叫做漏斗移位（funnel shift）的指令，直接复制八个字节。

sentences.en: So, so you want to copy four bytes into registers, and what you do is that you copy the eight bytes that surround those four bytes that you want,
sentences.zh: 因此，你想把四个字节复制到寄存器中，而你的做法是复制围绕着这四个所需字节的那八个字节，

sentences.en: because those four bytes are not even in one place or in one register or in another, they are in between.
sentences.zh: 因为这四个字节甚至不在同一个地方，不在某个单一寄存器中，也不在另一个寄存器中，它们处于中间位置。

sentences.en: And so you copy them both, and then the funnel shift basically just gives you part of that.
sentences.zh: 所以你把它们都复制下来，然后漏斗移位指令基本上就能给你其中的一部分。

sentences.en: The funnel shift instruction gives you part of that, of that eight byte.
sentences.zh: 漏斗移位指令能给你这八个字节中的一部分。

sentences.en: So it gives you four bytes out of those eight bytes that you have loaded.
sentences.zh: 也就是在你加载的那八个字节中提取出四个字节。

sentences.en: And so that way you can basically align it into registers, and then you can do aligned stores back into global memory.
sentences.zh: 通过这种方式，你基本上可以在寄存器中完成对齐，然后就能以对齐的存储方式写回全局内存。

sentences.en: So there's like a little, a couple of tricks that you need to do in order to make the global memory movement as good as possible.
sentences.zh: 所以，为了让全局内存的传输尽可能高效，你需要做这么一些小技巧。

sentences.en: So with the over copying thing,
sentences.zh: 那么，关于这个超额复制的做法，

sentences.en: I'm interested in knowing.
sentences.zh: 我很有兴趣了解一下。

sentences.en: But with the over copying thing, how does that help?
sentences.zh: 但说到超额复制，这到底是怎么起作用的呢？

sentences.en: Because you're, you're just copying more of a tile than you need, but then like, don't you end up with like, where the starting address does have to be offset by one?
sentences.zh: 因为你复制的分块比实际需要的多，但这样一来，起始地址难道不会必须偏移一个位置吗？

sentences.en: What do you mean by the starting address, address of what, of your tile or of the memory that you're copying?
sentences.zh: 你说的起始地址是什么意思？什么东西的起始地址？是你的分块，还是你正在复制的内存？

sentences.en: The memory that you're copying.

sentences.en: No, so let's say our array, our array starts at address zero, which is 32 by the line.

sentences.en: And then the tile that we want to copy starts at address one.
sentences.zh: 然后我们想要复制的分块从地址一开始。

sentences.en: So we forget about that.
sentences.zh: 所以我们先不管那个。

sentences.en: And we copy from address zero, but then in shared memory, in shared memory, the tile is still unaligned.
sentences.zh: 我们从地址零开始复制，但在共享内存中，这个分块依然是未对齐的。

sentences.en: It's still at address one.
sentences.zh: 它仍然在地址一。

sentences.en: Well, that's what we are actually interested in copying.
sentences.zh: 嗯，这才是我们真正感兴趣要复制的东西。

sentences.en: We just copy extra so that we can do the copies asynchronously.
sentences.zh: 我们只是多复制了一些，这样我们就可以异步执行复制操作了。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: I'm having an idea.

sentences.en: Oh, that could be interesting.
sentences.zh: 哦，那可能会很有意思。

sentences.zh: 我们将其用于卷积，因为对于卷积，你通常也得做类似的事情，即需要访问一堆模板（stencil）点。

sentences.en: And in particular for the case of like the one, the off by one, this might be interesting where it will,

sentences.zh: 它会为你构建一个矩阵，如果没有视觉图示可能很难理解，但它会为你构建一个矩阵，其中包含你的输入，

sentences.zh: 被分块并排列成移位的列。

sentences.zh: 然后每一列都会是对齐的。

sentences.en: Although I guess it is way like the downside is that it is shared memory.
sentences.zh: 不过我想它的缺点在于它是共享内存。

sentences.en: Nice.
sentences.zh: 不错。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: The thing that made, the thing that's maybe interesting to think about here is that like the,

sentences.zh: 你所面临的问题类似于模板（stencil）计算所面临的问题。

sentences.zh: 话说回来，这些对齐问题通常适用于哪些数据类型？

sentences.en: So if I get, if I get the best performance on an array of bytes, I should be able to get the best performance on any data type.
sentences.zh: 所以如果我在字节数组上获得了最佳性能，我也应该能够在任何数据类型上获得最佳性能。
